records.source: Build an annotation set by streaming crops, and register it for annotating.
records.translation: 通过流式裁剪构建标注数据集，并将其注册以供标注。

records.context: Annotation works on single-object extracted image regions. Producing them with Measure means running it over a whole laboratory microplate -- about twenty minutes for 52 microscope fields of view on a 30-core machine -- and running it again to cut the extracted image regions differently.
records.label: spacr.annotation_dataset#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Annotation works on single-object crops. Producing them with Measure means running it over a whole plate -- about twenty minutes for 52 fields on a 30-core machine -- and running it again to cut the crops differently.
records.translation: 标注处理的是单对象裁剪图。用 Measure 生成它们意味着要对整块板运行一遍 -- 在 30 核机器上处理 52 个视野约需二十分钟 -- 而要以不同方式裁剪，还得再运行一遍。

records.context: Every microscope field of view's objects are already described twice over once Measure has run: by the label masks inside the merged arrays, and by the coordinate columns in ``measurements.db``. Either is enough to cut extracted image regions from, so a second set can be built in seconds without measuring anything again.
records.label: spacr.annotation_dataset#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every field's objects are already described twice over once Measure has run: by the label masks inside the merged arrays, and by the coordinate columns in ``measurements.db``. Either is enough to cut crops from, so a second set can be built in seconds without measuring anything again.
records.translation: Measure 运行之后，每个视野的对象都已经有两种描述：合并数组中的标签掩膜，以及 ``measurements.db`` 中的坐标列。任一种都足以用来裁剪，因此第二个数据集可以在几秒内构建，而无需重新测量任何内容。

records.context: ComBat estimates the batch effect from whatever variation is left after the design matrix has absorbed the biology. That failure is silent: the corrected table looks cleaner, the batch diagnostic improves, and the treatment effect is gone.

records.source: ComBat estimates the batch effect from whatever variation is left after the design matrix has absorbed the biology. If the biology is not in that design, it is part of "whatever is left" and gets removed along with the plate effect. That failure is silent: the corrected table looks cleaner, the batch diagnostic improves, and the treatment effect is gone.
records.translation: ComBat 根据设计矩阵吸收生物学因素后剩下的变异来估计批次效应。如果生物学因素不在该设计中，它就属于 "whatever is left"（剩下的部分），会与板效应一起被去除。这种失败是无声的：校正后的表看起来更干净，批次诊断有所改善，而处理效应却消失了。

records.translation: 因此，在调用方回答这个问题之前，:func:`correct_batch_effects` 会拒绝运行 ``method="combat"``。请传入要保留的协变量，或传入这个常量，以明确记录没有需要保留的内容 -- 只有当每个批次都包含相同的条件组合，或输出用于无需保护任何对比的无监督嵌入时，这才成立。

records.context: ``center`` removes per-batch mean shifts while preserving the global mean. ``zscore`` aligns per-batch means and variances to the global distribution. ``robust_zscore`` does the same with median/MAD and is less sensitive to heavy-tailed single-cell measurements. ``control_center`` estimates only a location shift from negative/reference controls in every batch, preserving treatment dispersion and usually best preserving biology.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.correct_batch_effects#1

records.source: ``center`` removes per-batch mean shifts while preserving the global mean. ``zscore`` aligns per-batch means and variances to the global distribution. ``robust_zscore`` does the same with median/MAD and is less sensitive to heavy-tailed single-cell measurements. ``control_center`` estimates only a location shift from negative/reference controls in every batch, preserving treatment dispersion and usually best preserving biology.
records.translation: ``center`` 去除每个批次的均值偏移，同时保留全局均值。``zscore`` 将每个批次的均值和方差对齐到全局分布。``robust_zscore`` 使用中位数/MAD 做同样的处理，对重尾的单细胞测量值不那么敏感。``control_center`` 只根据每个批次中的阴性/参考对照估计位置偏移，保留处理的离散程度，通常最能保留生物学信息。

records.context: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` each worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry, so a correction registered only in the parent is applied to no field, and the processing session completes without an error while every number is uncorrected. :func:`enable_illumination_correction` therefore does more than register the hook: it writes the model path to :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` and appends ``spacr.illumination:install`` to ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``, which every start method inherits, so each worker installs the correction for itself. :func:`worker_delivery_status` reports whether that is actually in place, and :func:`enable_illumination_correction` prints it.
records.label: spacr.illumination#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` each worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry, so a correction registered only in the parent is applied to no field, and the run completes without an error while every number is uncorrected. :func:`enable_illumination_correction` therefore does more than register the hook: it writes the model path to :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` and appends ``spacr.illumination:install`` to ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``, which every start method inherits, so each worker installs the correction for itself. :func:`worker_delivery_status` reports whether that is actually in place, and :func:`enable_illumination_correction` prints it.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` 在 :class:`multiprocessing.Pool` 中测量视野。在 ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` 下，每个工作进程都是一个全新的解释器，其钩子注册表为空，因此只在父进程中注册的校正不会应用于任何视野，运行会在没有任何错误的情况下完成，而每个数值都未经校正。因此，:func:`enable_illumination_correction` 所做的不只是注册钩子：它还将模型路径写入 :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR`，并将 ``spacr.illumination:install`` 追加到 ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS`` 中，每种启动方式都会继承这些环境变量，因此每个工作进程都会自行安装校正。:func:`worker_delivery_status` 报告这一机制是否确实就位，:func:`enable_illumination_correction` 会将其打印出来。

records.context: **Retrospective, from the data itself**: a per-pixel median across many microscope fields of view of the laboratory microplate, followed by a fit of a smooth low-order surface.
records.label: spacr.illumination#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Retrospective, from the data itself**: a per-pixel median across many fields of the plate, followed by a fit of a smooth low-order surface.
records.translation: **回顾性地根据数据本身估计**：在板的多个视野之间逐像素取中位数，然后拟合一个平滑的低阶曲面。

records.context: *Why the median across microscope fields of view.* A pixel is covered by a cell in only a minority of the microscope fields of view on a laboratory microplate, so the across-microscope field of view median at that pixel sees background almost every time and the objects drop out. Each microscope field of view is first divided by its own median, so a densely-seeded microscope field of view does not pull the estimate up because it has more cells in it -- what is being averaged is the *relative* profile, not the brightness.
records.label: spacr.illumination#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: *Why the median across fields.* A pixel is covered by a cell in only a minority of the fields on a plate, so the across-field median at that pixel sees background almost every time and the objects drop out. Each field is first divided by its own median, so a densely-seeded field does not pull the estimate up because it has more cells in it -- what is being averaged is the *relative* profile, not the brightness.
records.translation: *为什么在视野之间取中位数。* 某个像素只在板上少数视野中被细胞覆盖，因此该像素处的跨视野中位数几乎每次看到的都是背景，对象就被排除掉了。每个视野先除以其自身的中位数，因此接种密度高的视野不会因为细胞多而拉高估计值 -- 被平均的是*相对*分布，而不是亮度。

records.translation: 处理 dtype 往返转换的是这个类，而不是钩子机制（参见 :func:`spacr.measure_hooks.apply_preprocessing_hooks`）。整数输入以 float32 进行校正，然后*四舍五入到最近值*，再截断到该 dtype 的范围内返回：

records.context: **round, not truncate.** Truncation would shave a mean of 0.5 counts off every corrected pixel. Averaged over a 500-pixel object that does not wash out -- it is a systematic, one-directional shift of exactly the kind this feature exists to remove. Rounding is unbiased.
records.label: spacr.illumination.IlluminationCorrector#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **round, not truncate.** Truncation would shave a mean of 0.5 counts off every corrected pixel. Averaged over a 500-pixel object that does not wash out -- it is a systematic, one-directional shift of exactly the kind this feature exists to remove. Rounding is unbiased.
records.translation: **四舍五入，而不是截尾。** 截尾会使每个校正后像素平均少 0.5 个计数。在一个 500 像素的对象上取平均，这种偏差不会抵消 -- 它是一种系统性的单向偏移，恰恰是本功能要去除的那一类偏差。四舍五入是无偏的。

records.context: **clip, and count.** A gain above 1 at the edge of the microscope field of view can push a near-full-scale pixel past the top of a uint16. Clipping is the only option that keeps the dtype the hook contract requires, and it removes real signal, so every pixel that was *below* full scale before the correction and lands *at* full scale after it is counted and reported. Pixels that were already saturated are not counted: they were saturated at acquisition, not by the correction.

records.context: 1. the model is saved to disk if it is not already there -- a ``spawn`` worker can only reach it through the file system; 2. :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` and :data:`ON_MISSING_ENV_VAR` are set; 3. ``spacr.illumination:install`` is appended to ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS`` (appended, not assigned -- another extension may already be in there), and the registry is then consulted so that this process installs the hook through that same environment route.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

records.source: It does nothing and returns None unless ``settings['illumination_correction']`` is True. records.translation: 除非 ``settings['illumination_correction']`` 为 True，否则它不执行任何操作并返回 None。出厂默认值为 False：校正需要主动启用，因此未设置该项的运行会以未校正的方式进行测量。在 verbose 模式下，设置关闭时的调用会打印 ``illumination_correction`` 为 False，因为在设置表单中，这种空操作看起来就像一个什么也不做的 Run 按钮。

records.context: Types, tooltips and the module description are contributed; categories are not. ``spacr.settings.categories`` is one shared, ordered map that every settings panel walks, and its growth is guarded by an exact-equality test against a hand-kept list. A structured-data name contributed at *import* time is in that map only in a session that imported this module, so contributing categories would make that test's result depend on which files pytest was pointed at.

records.source: Types, tooltips and the module description are contributed; categories are not. ``spacr.settings.categories`` is one shared, ordered map that every settings panel walks, and its growth is guarded by an exact-equality test against a hand-kept list. It finds the plate-column, guide, and plate-row barcode in each read, resolves those sequences against reference tables, and counts the resulting guides by well.  :func:`generate_barecode_mapping` is the GUI and Python entry point (the historical ``barecode`` spelling remains part of the public API); :func:`graph_sequencing_stats` can then help choose a read-fraction cutoff.
records.translation: **Map Barcodes** 模块将测序运行与基于图像的筛选联系起来。它在每条读段中找到板列、向导序列和板行条形码，根据参考表解析这些序列，并按孔统计所得的向导序列。:func:`generate_barecode_mapping` 是 GUI 和 Python 的入口函数（历史上的 ``barecode`` 拼写仍是公共 API 的一部分）；随后可以用 :func:`graph_sequencing_stats` 帮助选择读段比例截断值。

records.context: ``src`` must contain gzip-compressed FASTQ files whose names let spaCR pair R1 and R2 reads.  The run also needs a CSV reference table per barcode, with ``sequence`` and ``name`` columns.  A run that decodes the three barcodes spaCR shipped names them as ``row_csv``, ``column_csv`` and ``grna_csv``, and a run that decodes any other number of barcodes lists them under ``barcode_set`` instead, one entry per barcode.  ``target_sequence`` anchors the barcode window, while ``offset_start``, ``expected_end``, and a regex naming one group per barcode describe its layout.  The shipped regex names ``columnID``, ``grna`` and ``rowID``.  Use ``mode='paired'`` for a quality-weighted R1/R2 consensus or ``mode='single'`` with ``single_direction`` when only one mate should be read.
records.label: spacr.sequencing#4

records.translation: ``src`` 必须包含 gzip 压缩的 FASTQ 文件，其文件名应能让 spaCR 将 R1 和 R2 读段配对。运行还需要为每个条形码提供一张 CSV 参考表，包含 ``sequence`` 和 ``name`` 列。解码 spaCR 自带三个条形码的运行将它们命名为 ``row_csv``、``column_csv`` 和 ``grna_csv``；解码其他数量条形码的运行则在 ``barcode_set`` 下列出，每个条形码一项。``target_sequence`` 锚定条形码窗口，而 ``offset_start``、``expected_end`` 以及为每个条形码命名一个组的正则表达式描述其布局。自带的正则表达式命名了 ``columnID``、``grna`` 和 ``rowID``。使用 ``mode='paired'`` 可得到按质量加权的 R1/R2 一致序列；只应读取一端时，使用 ``mode='single'`` 并配合 ``single_direction``。

records.context: Three behaviours can produce plausible but incomplete output.  The anchor match is exact and a wrong regex silently rejects reads; reference sequences are compared in their stored orientation; and a sequence within ``barcode_mismatches`` of two references remains unassigned instead of being guessed.  Separately, read-level HDF5 output can be much larger than the count tables, and high compression may spend more time saving than decoding, so disable ``save_h5`` unless those individual annotations are needed.
records.label: spacr.sequencing#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three behaviours can produce plausible but incomplete output.  The anchor match is exact and a wrong regex silently rejects reads; reference sequences are compared in their stored orientation; and a sequence within ``barcode_mismatches`` of two references remains unassigned instead of being guessed.  Separately, read-level HDF5 output can be much larger than the count tables, and high compression may spend more time saving than decoding, so disable ``save_h5`` unless those individual annotations are needed.
records.translation: 有三种行为可能产生看似合理但不完整的输出。锚点匹配是精确匹配，错误的正则表达式会悄悄拒绝读段；参考序列按其存储方向进行比较；与两个参考序列的差异都在 ``barcode_mismatches`` 以内的序列会保持未分配，而不会被猜测。另外，读段级的 HDF5 输出可能比计数表大得多，高压缩级别花在保存上的时间可能比解码还多，因此除非需要这些单条注释，否则请关闭 ``save_h5``。

records.source: The two settings answer different questions. ``target_unique_count`` sets how many gRNAs a well should end up with and is answered from the counts; the calibration finds the cut-off at which imaging and sequencing agree and is answered from the control wells. The run reports both numbers, but the switch is read only in ``ml._perform_regression``, for three reasons.
records.translation: 这两个设置回答的是不同的问题。``target_unique_count`` 设定每个孔最终应有多少个 gRNAs，根据计数来回答；校准则找出成像与测序结果一致时的截断值，根据对照孔来回答。运行会报告这两个数值，但该开关只在 ``ml._perform_regression`` 中读取，原因有三。

records.context: First, the calibration needs imaging inputs -- a per-cell machine-learning classification model score, the microplate sample position each cell is in, and the laboratory microplate design naming the pure positive- and negative-control blocks. This function receives only the count tables, so reading the switch here would require undocumented structured-data names or a silent fallback to the counts-based answer when they are absent.

records.context: Instead of a hand-picked cutoff (such as 2% of a microplate sample position's reads), the user states the **biological** quantity instead — how many gRNAs per microplate sample position the design intends — and :func:`derive_threshold` solves for the abundance cutoff that delivers it. :func:`threshold_sweep` then walks a range around that cutoff so the trade-off is visible rather than asserted, and :func:`recommend_threshold` writes the answer out in words, with the derived number stated explicitly. records.source: Instead of a hand-picked cutoff (such as 2% of a well's reads), the user states the **biological** quantity instead — how many gRNAs per well the design intends — and :func:`derive_threshold` solves for the abundance cutoff that delivers it. :func:`threshold_sweep` then walks a range around that cutoff so the trade-off is visible rather than asserted, and :func:`recommend_threshold` writes the answer out in words, with the derived number stated explicitly. records.translation: 用户不再手工选择截断值（例如某孔读段的 2%），而是给出**生物学**上的数量 —— 即实验设计期望每孔有多少个 gRNAs —— 由 :func:`derive_threshold` 求解能达到该数量的丰度截断值。随后 :func:`threshold_sweep` 在该截断值周围的范围内进行扫描，使取舍关系可以被直接看到而不只是被断言，:func:`recommend_threshold` 则用文字写出结论，并明确给出推导出的数值。由用户根据曲线做出选择；这里不会替用户悄悄做出选择。

records.source: Two barcodes of the same length within ``max_distance`` substitutions are a **collision**: one miscalled base moves a read from one well (or one guide) to another, and nothing downstream can tell that it happened. Exact duplicates are reported too, at distance 0 — those are fatal rather than risky, and :func:`spacr.sequencing.map_sequences_to_names` refuses to run on them.
records.translation: 长度相同、替换差异在 ``max_distance`` 以内的两个条形码构成一次**碰撞**：一个碱基识别错误就会把一条读段从一个孔（或一个向导序列）移到另一个，而下游无法察觉这一点。完全相同的重复条形码也会被报告，距离为 0 —— 这些是致命问题而不只是风险，:func:`spacr.sequencing.map_sequences_to_names` 遇到它们会拒绝运行。

records.context: The search is exact rather than gridded: the gRNAs-per-microplate sample position statistic is a step function that can only change at a fraction actually present in the table, so every distinct observed fraction is a candidate and the monotonicity of the statistic (see :meth:`WellFractions.statistic_at`) lets a bisection find the answer in ``log2(n)`` evaluations. Where no cutoff hits the target exactly — the statistic is a median of integers and jumps — the candidate landing closest is returned, preferring the one that still *meets* the target over the one that falls short.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.derive_threshold#2

records.source: The search is exact rather than gridded: the gRNAs-per-well statistic is a step function that can only change at a fraction actually present in the table, so every distinct observed fraction is a candidate and the monotonicity of the statistic (see :meth:`WellFractions.statistic_at`) lets a bisection find the answer in ``log2(n)`` evaluations. Where no cutoff hits the target exactly — the statistic is a median of integers and jumps — the candidate landing closest is returned, preferring the one that still *meets* the target over the one that falls short.
records.translation: 搜索是精确的，而不是基于网格：每孔 gRNAs 统计量是一个阶梯函数，只可能在表中实际存在的比例处发生变化，因此每个不同的观测比例都是候选值，而统计量的单调性（参见 :meth:`WellFractions.statistic_at`）使二分法可以在 ``log2(n)`` 次评估内找到答案。当没有任何截断值恰好达到目标时 —— 统计量是整数的中位数，会发生跳变 —— 返回最接近的候选值，并优先选择仍能*达到*目标的那个，而不是未达到目标的那个。

records.context: **What the denominator is.** ``total_reads`` counts reads that matched the barcode regex — a read that never found the anchor sequence is not in the file at all. records.translation: **分母是什么。** ``total_reads`` 统计的是与条形码正则表达式匹配的读段 —— 从未找到锚定序列的读段根本不在该文件中。因此这些比例是 "of the reads that reached barcode lookup"（占进入条形码查找步骤的读段），而不是 "of the FASTQ"（占 FASTQ 全部读段）。正是这个数值可以诊断条形码参考错误或方向反了，这也正是该面板的用途；正则表达式本身漏掉读段的运行，已经在映射日志中报告了。

records.source: ``cellpose.transforms.convert_image`` — which ``CellposeModel.eval`` calls with whatever ``channel_axis`` it was handed — indexes ``x.shape[channel_axis]`` and rejects a non-``None`` axis outright for a 2-D input. The two shapes spaCR's loaders produce would therefore both be rejected with a hard-coded ``channel_axis=3``:
records.translation: ``cellpose.transforms.convert_image`` —— ``CellposeModel.eval`` 会用它收到的任何 ``channel_axis`` 调用该函数 —— 会对 ``x.shape[channel_axis]`` 进行索引，并且对二维输入会直接拒绝非 ``None`` 的轴。因此，如果硬编码 ``channel_axis=3``，spaCR 加载器产生的两种形状都会被拒绝：

records.context: Four things drive the design of the z half, and each of them is a place where a naive 3-D implementation silently produces wrong science:
records.label: spacr.zstack#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Four things drive the design of the z half, and each of them is a place where a naive 3-D implementation silently produces wrong science:
records.translation: 有四点决定了 z 部分的设计，每一点都是朴素的 3-D 实现会悄悄得出错误科学结论的地方：

records.context: **Anisotropy must be known.** Confocal z-spacing is routinely 3-10x the xy pixel size. A volume segmented as if it were isotropic merges objects along z, because a 3-image-layer gap that is really 3 um reads to the segmenter as 3 pixels. ``anisotropy`` here always means ``dz / dxy`` -- the z step divided by the xy pixel size -- which is the same convention Cellpose uses. It is a *required* input for volumetric segmentation: :func:`resolve_anisotropy` raises :class:`UnknownAnisotropyError` rather than defaulting to 1.0, because 1.0 is a claim about the microscope, not a neutral value.
records.label: spacr.zstack#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Anisotropy must be known.** Confocal z-spacing is routinely 3-10x the xy pixel size. A volume segmented as if it were isotropic merges objects along z, because a 3-plane gap that is really 3 um reads to the segmenter as 3 pixels. ``anisotropy`` here always means ``dz / dxy`` -- the z step divided by the xy pixel size -- which is the same convention Cellpose uses. It is a *required* input for volumetric segmentation: :func:`resolve_anisotropy` raises :class:`UnknownAnisotropyError` rather than defaulting to 1.0, because 1.0 is a claim about the microscope, not a neutral value.
records.translation: **必须已知各向异性。** 共聚焦的 z 间距通常是 xy 像素尺寸的 3-10x。按各向同性分割的体数据会沿 z 方向合并对象，因为实际为 3 um 的 3 个平面的间隔，在分割器看来只是 3 个像素。这里的 ``anisotropy`` 始终表示 ``dz / dxy`` -- 即 z 步长除以 xy 像素尺寸 -- 这与 Cellpose 使用的约定相同。它是体分割的*必需*输入：:func:`resolve_anisotropy` 会引发 :class:`UnknownAnisotropyError`，而不是默认为 1.0，因为 1.0 是对显微镜的一种断言，而不是中性值。

records.context: **Objects touching the first or last image layer are truncated.** Exactly as an object touching the xy microscope field of view edge is truncated. Their volume is a lower bound and their shape statistics are meaningless. :func:`flag_truncated_z` marks them, mirroring the reasoning ``spacr.seg_qc`` already established for xy border objects (see ``seg_qc._score_labels``, which counts border objects and then excludes them from every size statistic).

records.source: **Objects touching the first or last plane are truncated.** Exactly as an object touching the xy field edge is truncated. records.translation: **接触第一个或最后一个平面的对象是被截断的。** 这与接触 xy 视野边缘的对象被截断完全一样。它们的体积只是下限，其形状统计量毫无意义。:func:`flag_truncated_z` 会标记它们，这沿用了 ``spacr.seg_qc`` 对 xy 边界对象已经确立的推理（参见 ``seg_qc._score_labels``，它统计边界对象，然后将其排除在所有尺寸统计量之外）。

records.context: **A single-image layer volume is 2-D, not degenerate 3-D.** ``n_z == 1`` short-circuits to :data:`MODE_SINGLE_PLANE`, which calls ``segment_fn`` on the plain 2-D image layer and returns a 2-D mask. It does not resample, does not stitch, and does not consult anisotropy.

records.source: Each plane is compared with the plane below it, and the pairing is greedy and **one-to-one**: pairs are considered in descending IoU and a label may take part in at most one link. That is what stops two genuinely different objects that merely happen to overlap the same object in xy from being fused -- only the better match inherits the label, the other starts a new one. Any pair below ``iou_threshold`` is not linked at all.
records.translation: 每个平面都与其下方的平面进行比较，配对方式是贪心的**一对一**匹配：按 IoU 降序考虑各个配对，每个标签最多参与一次链接。这样可以防止两个确实不同、只是恰好在 xy 上与同一对象重叠的对象被融合 -- 只有匹配更好的那个继承该标签，另一个则开始新的标签。IoU 低于 ``iou_threshold`` 的配对完全不会被链接。

records.context: Unlike ``cellpose.utils.stitch3D``, new labels are always drawn from a single monotonically increasing counter. records.label: spacr.zstack.stitch_planes#2

records.source: Unlike ``cellpose.utils.stitch3D``, new labels are always drawn from a single monotonically increasing counter. records.translation: 与 ``cellpose.utils.stitch3D`` 不同，新标签始终取自单个单调递增的计数器。Cellpose 在遇到空平面后会重置计数器，因此在那里 ``[objects] [empty] [objects]`` 会悄悄重复使用标签 ID 并合并无关的对象；而在这里，空平面不会链接任何内容。

records.translation: 尺寸恰好只在一列中报告，绝不会出现在两列：``volume_voxels`` 用于 ``(T, Z, Y, X)`` 堆栈，``area_px2`` 用于 ``(T, Y, X)`` 堆栈。它们是不同的量，把其中一种写入另一种的列，是破坏筛选数据最容易的方式 -- 这也正是 :data:`spacr.zstack.VOLUME_STATS_UNITS` 存在的意义。只有在体素尺寸和帧间隔已知时，才会出现微米和秒的列。
